versions.description: v0.1: mono DBAP spatializer -- js dbap.js solver, lcd room plan + 8 meters, mc gain lane to mc.dac~ 1-8, presentation layout
v0.2: dbap-source.maxpat abstraction (bpatcher, #1 instance name), 2-instance host, verify ping, per-speaker trims, scenes via pattrstorage
v0.3: stereo width with two DBAP sub-points (SourceShaper port), gen~ Schroeder all-pass decorrelator, mono/stereo bpatcher arg #2, R gain lane + mc.+~ sum
v0.4: air filter (TPT one-pole per feed in gen~, cutoff from js), convex hull projection + hull trim, z-cue, air/hull live.dials, D20 merged weights/trims layout

v0.5: separate dbap-motion bpatcher (motion.js Task clock, six paths, scene-synced), motion/trace in dbap.js + third inlet and scene outlet on dbap-source, host alignment delays (mc.delay~ from venue delayMs), venue read, tools/venue_to_json.py
v0.5.1: spiral path makes 6 turns per cycle with continuous rotation (D25, deviates from the plugin's one-turn lobe); 120-point trace for spiral

v0.6: gesture recorder in dbap-motion (seventh path 'recorded': rec toggle, 120-point centroid-relative gesture in pattr gesture, glide-back loop, UI feedback outlet on motion.js); anchorm / setanchor / recstate in dbap.js; anchorm on the source's scene outlet; host unchanged
v0.7: wander (seeded noise on top of any path), loop menu (loop / palindrome / one-shot), cue button + cue message on the module inlet, open trace; motion face 360 -> 460 wide, host bpatcher widened
v0.7.1: '<control> <value>' messages into both bpatchers (source: p ctlsplit with routepass on the third inlet -> pattrstorage; motion: already routed, assistance text only)
v0.7.2: control-demo.maxpat, a teaching patch for the D35 control messages (one source + one motion module, message boxes, live slider / number / MIDI examples, how-it-works panel)
